title: Happy Birthday to You
writers: Mildred J. Hill and Patty Smith Hill, credited for the tune 'Good Morning to All'; authorship of the 'Happy Birthday' lyrics is undocumented

evidence.note: The tune 'Good Morning to All' was published by the Hill sisters in 1893; the 'Happy Birthday to You' lyrics first appeared in print in 1912 with no copyright notice or credit. On September 22, 2015, a federal judge ruled Warner/Chappell's claimed 1935 copyright covered only a piano arrangement, not the lyrics or melody, and on June 30, 2016 the court declared the song to be in the public domain.

famous_use: Per the 1998 Guinness World Records, it is the most recognized song in the English language.
